confidenceCalibration.scope: v3 calibration promotion readiness; excludes Unity Editor, device, Gate 6B, signing, and product activation
confidenceCalibration.note: Gate 6B device evidence, independent validation, product-owner approval artifact, HMAC receipt, and backend replay protection are not complete. New calibration evidence requires aura.face3d-profile.v3; v1/v2 remain legacy read-only. Calibrated self-claims remain blocked.

offlineDiagnostics17.scope: historical 17-capture gross sanity evidence; not repeatability, population norms, or v3 calibration validation
offlineDiagnostics17.scopeWarning: The 17 captures mix three subjects, poses, and repeats. Overall ranges are gross sanity evidence, not within-person repeatability or population norms.

endToEndProductPath.scope: historical G2 product-path integration before v3 calibration/profile changes
endToEndProductPath.interpretationBoundary: faceScale-normalized relative values; not millimeters, medical diagnosis, percentiles, or population grades

historicalG2UnityEditor.scope: Aura.Face3D EditMode tests for G2 integration before v3 calibration/profile changes
historicalG2UnityEditor.note: The result path was local and is not a committed artifact. The validated code SHA predates all v3 calibration/profile changes and must not be reused as current v3 evidence.

historicalG2RepositorySnapshot.scope: historical Node, mobile, backend, clean-install, CI, typecheck, and diff summary recorded before v3 changes
historicalG2RepositorySnapshot.note: No immutable artifact binds the complete reported workspace to one exact SHA, so this section is historical context only.

currentV3StaticNodeValidation.scope: static Unity source policy/promotion guard, embedded-runtime preflight fixtures, calibration registry, and repeatability Node contracts; excludes Unity Editor and devices
currentV3StaticNodeValidation.note: Exact commit binding is intentionally null to avoid a self-referential registry commit. CI/review artifacts must bind these commands to an immutable SHA.

currentV3UnityEditorValidation.scope: Unity compilation and EditMode tests for v3 schema, immutable 5-of-8 policy, and calibration producer defaults
currentV3UnityEditorValidation.note: No Unity Editor validation has run for the current v3 changes. Static source checks are not a substitute.

historicalDeviceEvidence.scope: historical G1 five-metric device runtime only; excludes G2 landmarks and v3 calibration
historicalDeviceEvidence.note: These runs predate the current G2 landmark map and do not prove current G2 runtime extraction.

remainingRisks: ARKit fixed topology does not guarantee clinical landmark homology.
The anatomy review was performed by the product owner, not two independent trained raters.
The 17-capture cohort is too small and unbalanced for population generalization.
New G2 device runtime and 3x3 repeatability were explicitly waived, not passed.
Population labels such as wide or protruding require a separate reference distribution.
